name: Small Fiber Neuropathy
definition: Neuropathy predominantly affecting thinly myelinated A-delta and unmyelinated C fibers, causing neuropathic pain and autonomic symptoms with often normal routine nerve-conduction studies.

investigations.principle: Cause-directed metabolic/immune testing is important; skin biopsy or autonomic testing may support diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, infection, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Normal routine nerve-conduction studies do not exclude small-fiber neuropathy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata-neuropathy phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Neuropathy predominantly affecting thinly myelinated A-delta and unmyelinated C fibers, causing neuropathic pain and autonomic symptoms with often normal routine nerve-conduction studies.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, major trauma, suspected infection, pathological fracture, neurovascular compromise or other listed red flags.
